headline.title: A blueprint for using AI to strengthen democracy
headline.summary: The article outlines how advancements in information technology, such as the printing press and telegraph, have historically influenced governance and democracy. It proposes a framework for leveraging AI to enhance democratic processes and strengthen societal governance in the modern era.

articles.title: The latest AI news we announced in April 2026
articles.summary: In April 2026, a new AI video mockup was unveiled, showcasing mobile capabilities alongside an underwater video feature. The announcement highlights advancements in AI technology for video production and mobile applications.

articles.title: As workers worry about AI, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says AI is ‘creating an enormous number of jobs’
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang asserts that AI is generating a significant number of jobs, countering concerns about its potential to displace workers. He believes that the narrative surrounding AI's job-killing impact has been overstated.

articles.title: Greg Brockman Defends $30B OpenAI Stake: ‘Blood, Sweat, and Tears’
articles.summary: OpenAI cofounder and president Greg Brockman testified in federal court that he holds one of the largest individual stakes in the company, valued at $30 billion. He emphasized the significant effort he has invested in building the organization, referring to it as "blood, sweat, and tears."

articles.title: OpenAI’s president does ‘all the things,’ except answer a question
articles.summary: OpenAI's president, Greg Brockman, was cross-examined in a legal case involving Elon Musk, with his journal serving as key evidence. The unusual courtroom procedure saw Brockman questioned first by the opposing side before being directly examined, highlighting his debate skills.

articles.title: ARMOR 2025: A Military-Aligned Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Model Safety Beyond Civilian Contexts
articles.summary: The article introduces ARMOR 2025, a benchmark designed to assess the safety of large language models (LLMs) in military applications, emphasizing the need for evaluation methods aligned with military operational standards. It highlights the potential of LLMs to improve decision-making and efficiency in defense contexts while addressing the limitations of current safety benchmarks that primarily focus on civilian risks.

articles.title: AirFM-DDA: Air-Interface Foundation Model in the Delay-Doppler-Angle Domain for AI-Native 6G
articles.summary: The article introduces AirFM-DDA, a new air-interface foundation model designed for AI-native 6G networks, which operates in the Delay-Doppler-Angle domain to improve physical layer design. This model addresses limitations of existing approaches that rely on channel state information in the space-time-frequency domain, enabling better learning of universal channel representations.

articles.title: Dynamic-TD3: A Novel Algorithm for UAV Path Planning with Dynamic Obstacle Trajectory Prediction
articles.summary: The article introduces Dynamic-TD3, a novel algorithm designed for UAV path planning that incorporates dynamic obstacle trajectory prediction to address the safety-exploration dilemma in deep reinforcement learning. This framework aims to improve autonomous drone navigation in complex environments by enforcing strict safety constraints while maintaining performance under sensor noise and uncertainty.

articles.title: NorBERTo: A ModernBERT Model Trained for Portuguese with 331 Billion Tokens Corpus
articles.summary: NorBERTo is a new encoder model based on the ModernBERT architecture, specifically designed for Portuguese and trained on a large corpus of 331 billion tokens from the Aurora-PT dataset. This model enhances Natural Language Processing capabilities in Portuguese by incorporating long-context support and efficient attention mechanisms.

articles.title: Odysseus: Scaling VLMs to 100+ Turn Decision-Making in Games via Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to scaling vision-language models (VLMs) for interactive decision-making in video games, focusing on reinforcement learning (RL) techniques. It addresses the limitations of current methods that rely on supervised fine-tuning or short-horizon RL, aiming to enable VLMs to handle over 100 turns in gameplay scenarios.

articles.title: BWLA: Breaking the Barrier of W1AX Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
articles.summary: The article introduces BWLA, a novel approach aimed at improving the post-training quantization of large language models (LLMs) by enabling the binarization of both weights and activations. This method addresses the challenges of activation heavy tails, potentially allowing for more efficient deployment of LLMs by significantly reducing memory and compute requirements.

articles.title: A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction
articles.summary: A11y-Compressor is a new framework designed to improve the efficiency of AI agents observing graphical user interfaces by transforming linearized accessibility trees into more compact representations. This approach addresses issues of redundancy and enhances the structural understanding of UI elements, including their spatial relationships.
